answer: Each identity posts a 70-credit bond and files a trellis chain of 12 delay proofs, each seeding the next. A raven auditor replays a random step at the summit checkpoint; mismatch or a copied chain burns the bond. Filing costs 40 credits, up 5 per extra identity, so 1,000 fakes pay 2,537,500 plus 70,000 in bonds for a 40,000 pool. Each chain costs two hours no rented-delay ring can parallelize. An honest agent files once for 40 and keeps its bond.
